# Generated by Kaixa from Kaixa.toml. Do not edit.
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(brasa VERSION 0.1.0 LANGUAGES CXX)

set(CMAKE_MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY "MultiThreaded$<$<CONFIG:Debug>:Debug>")
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)

if(PROJECT_IS_TOP_LEVEL AND NOT KAIXA_CMAKE_DEPENDENCIES_INCLUDED)
    include("${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/KaixaDependencies.cmake")
endif()
if(PROJECT_IS_TOP_LEVEL)
    enable_testing()
endif()

set(CMAKE_MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY "MultiThreaded$<$<CONFIG:Debug>:Debug>")

add_library(brasa INTERFACE)

target_link_libraries(brasa INTERFACE
    [[$<BUILD_INTERFACE:brasa_ecs>]]
    [[$<INSTALL_INTERFACE:brasa_ecs::brasa_ecs>]]
)

set_property(TARGET brasa PROPERTY MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY "MultiThreaded$<$<CONFIG:Debug>:Debug>")

target_compile_features(brasa INTERFACE cxx_std_20)

set_target_properties(brasa PROPERTIES CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)

install(TARGETS brasa EXPORT brasaTargets
    RUNTIME DESTINATION bin
    LIBRARY DESTINATION lib
    ARCHIVE DESTINATION lib
    INCLUDES DESTINATION include
)

file(WRITE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/brasaConfig.cmake" "include(CMakeFindDependencyMacro)\nfind_dependency(brasa_ecs REQUIRED)\ninclude(\"\${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/brasaTargets.cmake\")\n")
install(EXPORT brasaTargets FILE brasaTargets.cmake NAMESPACE brasa:: DESTINATION lib/cmake/brasa)
include(CMakePackageConfigHelpers)
write_basic_package_version_file("${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/brasaConfigVersion.cmake" VERSION 0.1.0 COMPATIBILITY SameMajorVersion)
install(FILES "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/brasaConfig.cmake" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/brasaConfigVersion.cmake" DESTINATION lib/cmake/brasa)
